2609.09793.title: How Fragile Is Safety Alignment at Frontier Scale? A Single-Direction Attack on a 320B MoE
2609.09793.paper_summary: Directional ablation removes an aligned language model's ability to refuse by projecting a single "refusal direction" out of the weights that write the residual stream. It needs no gradient-based training and no optimization, only a few hundred contrastive prompts, which makes it the canonical white-box attack on open-weight alignment. However, it has been established only on dense models up to roughly 70B parameters. We study whether it survives the shift to frontier mixture-of-experts (MoE) models whose residual streams are no longer a single tensor and whose weights ship quantized. We apply it to GLM-5.3-Flash (320B parameters, 288 routed experts, a four-wide hyper-connection residual, block-FP8). The attack survives the architecture, but what it reaches is no longer where a reader of the original recipe would look for it. Editing the attention, dense and routed-expert writers on their own removes 0.039, 0.016 and 0.148 of refusal respectively; editing all three together removes 0.776. As a result, 74% of the effect exists only under the joint intervention. The part the conventional recipe reaches by module-name matching accounts for 0.066 of that 0.776, which is why it fails silently on an MoE. The effect does not follow from removing just any direction: ablating a random direction orthogonal to it leaves refusal unchanged. A category-concentrated residue survives every edit we tried: subspaces fitted on violence, sexual content and hate leave measurable refusal at every rank from 1 to 12. We report the method, the 41-89 percentage-point reductions it achieves across seven harmful benchmarks with no detected change in capability, and the boundary where it stops.
2609.09793.paper_summary_zh: 方向性消融透過從寫入殘差流的權重中投影出單一的「拒絕方向」，移除了對齊語言模型拒絕的能力。它不需要基於梯度的訓練和優化，只需幾百個對比提示，這使它成為對開放權重對齊的經典白盒攻擊。然而，它僅在大約70B參數的密集模型上建立。 我們研究它是否能在前沿的專家混合（MoE）模型中存活，這些模型的殘差流不再是單一的張量，且其權重是量化的。我們將其應用於GLM-5.3-Flash（320B參數，288個路由專家，四寬超連接殘差，block-FP8）。該攻擊在架構上存活，但它所達到的地方不再是原始配方的讀者會尋找的地方。單獨編輯注意力、密集和路由專家寫入者分別移除0.039、0.016和0.148的拒絕；三者一起編輯則移除0.776。因此，74%的效果僅在聯合干預下存在。傳統配方透過模塊名稱匹配所達到的部分佔0.066的0.776，這就是為什麼它在MoE上默默失敗的原因。該效果並不僅僅來自於移除任何方向：消融一個隨機的正交方向不會改變拒絕。集中於類別的殘留在我們嘗試的每次編輯中都存活：針對暴力、色情內容和仇恨的子空間在每個等級從1到12都留下可測量的拒絕。我們報告了這種方法，它在七個有害基準中達到的41-89個百分點的減少，且未檢測到能力的變化，以及它停止的邊界。
